execution_owner: root Karen; read-only agent review; not formal Pro/Ultra/human acceptance
purpose: Train the six already-connected native teachers while replaying nine existing quote teachers; compare actual 4B meaning and body, not only training loss.
loss: full assistant labels including EOS; prompt masked; no new surface/evidence mask
dtype: existing BF16 base with existing F32 LoRA
gradient_checkpointing: use_reentrant=False; restore train mode and use_cache=False after baseline
cost_scope: Process-time apportionment only. Preparation, recovery, continuing pod retention/storage/transfer/tax are separate. Existing keep-running instruction continues.
deadline_scope: Global wall-clock covers model loading, before6, train15, save/reload and after15. Final hash/archive/recovery can take additional time; not an OS hard-stop guarantee. All 21 calls are not guaranteed to complete.
baseline_policy: Malformed JSON, non-adoption or token-cap non-EOS are preserved as failed baseline evidence; continue only the already-fixed one pass. A per-call timeout, OOM, exception, nonfinite tensor/gradient, identity mismatch, or global deadline ends the whole unit.
after_policy: Preserve each raw and finish reason, do not repair or re-call. Non-EOS/non-adoption is failure, not fit success. No extra update or successor trial. Stop on runtime failures/deadlines.
save_policy: Keep initial adapter read-only. Save a separate adapter immediately after training; archive before evaluation. Verify 32 finite tensors and hashes at save/reload/after, recover raw and completed/partial artifacts off Pod. No exact optimizer/RNG resume claim.
cmee_check: Use unchanged generated raw with exact frozen source/prior through quote compilation, receipt, meaning adoption and body. For adopted new6, same snapshot cold-file save/reload/NoGeneration result read with no extra model call. Frozen teacher prior is explicitly synthetic; no actual service round-trip claim.
success: All15 EOS and CMEE meaning/body; new6 per-source subject/time/polarity/perception/unknown/question-END/update semantics; all actual bodies read. A failed row remains failed. Fit success is not generalization or product acceptance.
teacher_provenance: Existing Karen edits/synthetic supplements; no Mash full-response gold. No new teacher text, failed raw, E05/E01/E03/A03 or withdrawn book-club material.
old_quote_baseline: Previous native9/9 used numeric chair plus quote daily. Quote-unified chair accuracy of old45779 is not measured; after old9 failures cannot be called regression from quote9/9.
memory_boundary: 7935-token learning on A4500 is not yet proved; OOM ends the unit, no fallback dtype/batch/mask/dependency/GPU change.
prohibited: dependency install or external generative API
user DB data or Render/Supabase effects
automatic retry, additional LR/mask/epoch search or raw rewriting
